qualification.scope_note: Source/package qualification only; no installed S04 behavior is claimed.

scope_exclusions: Do not execute bundled identity issuer or callback canonicalization commands as part of S04.
Preserve Identity and shared pointers at the reviewed 482 release.
No real customer grant, payment, or real-mail batch is authorized by this review.

package_copy.basis: Pins the reviewed binding bytes; checks exact input tuple, ZIP/tar/manifest hashes and counts; authenticates the existing release installer against package bytes; invokes only deploy --env stage; verifies installed payload and unchanged pointers; checks reserve. It does not activate code, migrate the DB, or edit configuration.

findings.finding: The preflight verifies source ancestry for admin-current, web-current, and identity-current, but omits site-current and current. site-current is overwritten, and current is preserved. An unexpected or external pointer target can therefore be overwritten without baseline validation.
findings.minimum_fix: Before any migration, require all five symlinks to resolve inside the owned releases namespace and verify the expected 482 source for each pointer, or explicitly prove the intended per-pointer baseline. Preserve exact old targets for rollback.

findings.finding: The canonical URL preflight omits ALISA_CANONICAL_AUTH_ENABLED and ALISA_IDENTITY_ISSUER checks. The c866 web/admin/platform code requires canonical-auth mode and the id.octoport.ru issuer for the already-canonical origins; health readiness may not exercise browser login configuration.
findings.minimum_fix: Require the exact canonical-auth flag and issuer in the relevant web, admin, platform, and identity configs before migration or pointer changes; keep the checks secret-free.

findings.finding: The activation plan check only requires the entitlements migration substring and excludes two named initial migrations. It does not prove that no additional migration operation will run. The post-migration check confirms the entitlements row but not the full migration-ledger delta.
findings.minimum_fix: Require the parsed migration plan to contain exactly entitlements.0001_initial and compare the pre/post migration ledger so the sole added row is that migration.

findings.finding: Activation verifies only runtime UPDATE denial. The migration revokes UPDATE, DELETE, and TRUNCATE on accessgrant, accessadjustment, and accesspreview; actual-stage verification does not currently confirm all nine table/privilege combinations.
findings.minimum_fix: Before enabling the capability, verify UPDATE, DELETE, and TRUNCATE are denied for the runtime role on each of the three immutable tables.

rollout_document.finding: The document still binds a008 and the previous 0f22/3e91/b8a5/77d0 baseline, old admin origin, and the retired inactive-payload hardlink installer. It does not describe the c866/482 canonical baseline or the current normal-copy installer/activation scripts.
rollout_document.minimum_fix: Replace the rollout steps and bindings with the exact c866 package tuple, current 482 pointer/origin baseline, reviewed normal-copy procedure, resource budget, rollback behavior, and READY_FOR_OWNER_TEST limit before activation.

installed_acceptance: Not performed by this reviewer. Require fresh read-only host readback and owner-run functional test; no OWNER role creation or handover.
